WITH counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
avg_c AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_orders FROM counts
),
above AS (
  SELECT c.account_id, c.order_count, c.order_count - a.avg_orders AS diff_avg
  FROM counts c
  CROSS JOIN avg_c a
  WHERE c.order_count > a.avg_orders
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_above FROM above
)
SELECT ab.account_id, ab.order_count, ab.diff_avg, ab.order_count - aa.avg_above AS diff_above_avg
FROM above ab
CROSS JOIN above_avg aa
ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
